integrity: The proof explicitly identifies the line graph of a friendship graph, proves sharp pagewise lower bounds for both resolving notions, constructs all equality cases, and counts them. The standalone verifier independently builds the line graph and checks both definitions directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to friendship graphs with at least two triangular pages.
Generalized windmills with larger clique blades and other wheel-related families are not covered.
The 2019 friendship-graph edge metric dimension uses vertex landmarks and is a different invariant from the edge-version metric dimension used here.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 6 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed line-graph doubly resolving result.
title: Edge-version metric and double metric bases of friendship graphs
